title: Kospi Index Trends in India as Global Chipmaker Selloff Deepens
description: The KOSPI index, representing South Korea's stock market, is trending in India amid a global chipmaker selloff that has caused the index to drop 7%.

sections.heading: Kospi Index Overview
paragraphs: The KOSPI index is a stock market index representing the performance of the largest and most liquid stocks of South Korean companies listed on the Korea Exchange.
According to Reuters, South Korea's KOSPI drops 7% as global chipmaker selloff deepens.

sections.heading: Link with US Tech Stocks
paragraphs: CNBC reports that U.S. and Korean tech stocks are now tightly linked, which could be a worry for investors.

sections.heading: Market Performance
paragraphs: The Economic Times notes that South Korean shares turn lower as chipmakers fall ahead of earnings.
